description:
Pubu Xianming, 'waterfall immortal tea', is a green from Yuyao, in the Ningbo area of eastern Zhejiang. It is listed under the names Yuyao Pubu Cha and Xianming among the province's regional teas, and today it features on the Ningbo tea-tourism trails.

Little is documented about how it is made or how it differs from its neighbours. Nothing firm can be said about its leaf shape or grade, so treat any single seller's account with care.

If you find it, brew it as you would other Zhejiang spring greens: water below the boil and a short first steep. Those are general habits for the class rather than anything known of this tea.

As with any little-known regional green, ask for the harvest year and who made it.
history: Little is documented about when this tea took its present form or who made it known. It appears in lists of Zhejiang regional teas under Yuyao's name and in current promotion of Ningbo's tea routes, and a firm history cannot be given beyond that.
